lines.trans: Xingzi, Xiao Yao and Lv Yi are honestly impossible to deal with.
They flatly refuse to apologise in public.
What did the two of them say?
One refuses to bow her head, and the other demands a private apology first.
Who are you two talking about over here?
Bu Xiaogu, I spoke rather harshly last time; I am sorry.
It is alright, Mr Chun Yuqiao.
I am formally apologising to you.
You really do not need to apologise to me; I am truly fine.
Just accept it.
Alright, thank you, Mr Chun Yuqiao.
